_comment: Intervention types Patrick OS can select between. A mechanism is WHAT gets
sold or delivered; it is not the same as the stage of work, and it is not the
same as which model runs the step.
This registry exists so that no code has to know that a website rebuild is a
possible outcome. Site Factory is the executor for exactly one row here.
Adding a non-website intervention is an edit to this file, not to Python.
status: 'available'  an executor exists and has been run
'declared'   the mechanism is real but nothing here executes it yet
'blocked'    an executor exists but is gated (see the project record)

website.label: Web-based intervention
website.description: Rebuilds, landing pages, and fixes to a site's structure or copy.
evidence_required: the page was actually retrieved (fetch_status ok)
identity verified to at least medium confidence
an observable defect a person can point at
website._note: Site Factory is the EXECUTOR for this mechanism, not the decision engine that chooses it. Both of its gates are NO-GO; see projects/site-factory.md.

positioning.label: Positioning and claim repair
positioning.description: Separating supported claims from aspirations and contradictions, and recommending what to preserve, eliminate, reposition, or test. The Narrative Decision Audit is this mechanism at the audit tier.
evidence_required: the claims the business currently makes, quoted
positioning._note: Per Patrick's own positioning note this is the cash engine's repeatable offer, and it is not a website intervention. Nothing here executes it yet, which is exactly the gap a website-shaped system would never surface.

messaging.label: Outbound messaging and sequence repair
messaging.description: The messages themselves: what is claimed, what is cited, what is asked for.

pricing.label: Pricing and packaging
pricing.description: What is charged, for what unit, at what commitment.
evidence_required: what was actually paid, not quoted

ops-automation.label: Operational automation
ops-automation.description: Removing a repeated manual step. Patrick OS is itself an instance of this mechanism.
evidence_required: the repeated step, observed more than once

none.label: No intervention supported
none.description: The diagnosis does not support selling anything yet. A first-class outcome, not a failure to decide.
none._note: Mechanism selection must be able to conclude this, or it is not selection. Site Factory had no way to express it: SF-03 turned a crawler timeout into a qualified rebuild opportunity at score 90.
